entries.708e978496ef5afc: It sets forth a medium- to long-term vision, "From operations to solutions," and aims, on the foundation of the operational capabilities it has cultivated, to acquire the ability to provide solutions that draw out and solve true needs through dialogue with customers. It sets its target market as B to B logistics, and aims to provide value in the machine tool, precision equipment and medical equipment fields, where it can leverage its strength in packaging technology. Under the 3-year medium-term management plan formulated in May 2026 (fiscal year ending March 2027 to fiscal year ending March 2029), it lists as priority measures improving profitability through expansion of domestic logistics bases and maximum utilization of existing assets, and maximizing added value through deployment of high-value-added services starting from warehouses in the United States, and states that it will promote sustainability as a foundation strategy.
